description: This file contains unit tests for the HealthStore component, specifically testing how the store's state reacts to a probe failure of a linked channel within the HealthSnapshot and verifying the degradation state and messaging.

classes.name: HealthStoreStateTests
classes.description: A test suite struct for testing HealthStore related functionalities in the application.

methods.name: `linked channel probe failure degrades state`
methods.description: A test method verifying that a probe failure on a linked channel causes the HealthStore state to transition into a degraded state and that appropriate messages are generated.
